name: Transit fare
description: A ticket on the municipal rail. Needs a record on file.
successText: The turnstile accepts your band and clicks. A ticket prints.

refusals.null_state: The turnstile reads your band, finds nothing, and displays: PENDING REVIEW. Please wait for an officer.

name: Forged Stacks day pass
description: A pass for the Stacks that will fool a basic scan, and not a thorough one.
successText: Sam slides a card across the counter. It looks real. It is not.

name: Sell scrap wire
successText: Two bundles of wire for twelve credits. Sam weighs it twice.

refusals.requirements: Sam wants at least two bundles of scrap wire.

name: Bribe the records clerk
description: A clerk opens a record for you, in someone else's name.
successText: The clerk never looks up. Your band now carries a record. It is not yours.

name: Quiet Hours forgery
description: During reconciliation the records are in flux, and a pass slips in cheaply. Only works between 02:00 and 05:00.
successText: The record flickers while it is written. By morning it will be gone, but tonight it holds.

refusals.requirements: Not now. The records are steady outside Quiet Hours, and nobody forges anything on a steady record.
